scientific_limitations_integrity: This finite exact calculation treats the ordinary independence complex of the rank-three seven-point binary Fano matroid, with integral homology under one Singer C7 subgroup. It does not determine the complete integral module under GL_3(F_2), other matroids, or the integral equivariant homotopy type. General matroid shellability and complex-coefficient equivariant results are prior work; independently verified publication novelty is not claimed. All exact certificate arithmetic is reproducible from verify_fano.py.
title: Integral Singer-cycle homology lattice of the Fano matroid complex
